tool_schemas.name: list_calls
tool_schemas.description: Lists calls in the specified workspace and returns a paged collection of call records filtered by status, source, time ranges, or upstream gong_call_id, sorted by the requested field and order; the response includes up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available (pass cursor to continue). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id does not match the required pattern, when limit is outside 1–200, when any date-time filter is invalid, or when unsupported enum values are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED or FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND when the workspace_id does not exist.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list calls for (e.g., gong_ws_01H...).

status.description: Filter calls by one or more call statuses.

started_at_gte.description: Filter calls that started at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

started_at_lte.description: Filter calls that started at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

ended_at_gte.description: Filter calls that ended at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

ended_at_lte.description: Filter calls that ended at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

gong_call_id.description: Filter by the upstream Gong call ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous request.

tool_schemas.name: retrieve_transcripts
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves structured transcript data for one or more internal call_ids in the given workspace, optionally including speaker index, topics, and timestamped sentences; when include_sentences is true, sentences are paged per call using sentences_limit and sentences_cursor and may be further filtered by time bounds and speaker_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id or any call_id fails its pattern, when call_ids is empty, when sentences_limit is outside 1–5000, when sentence_start_ms_gte/sentence_end_ms_lte are negative, or when sentence pagination/filter parameters are provided in an incompatible way (for example, sentences_cursor without include_sentences). Raises UNAUTHORIZED or FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND when the workspace or any requested call does not exist in that workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the calls/transcripts.

call_ids.description: One or more internal call IDs to retrieve transcripts for.

include_sentences.description: Whether to include timestamped transcript sentences in the response.

include_topics.description: Whether to include detected/derived topics in the response.

include_speaker_index.description: Whether to include the transcript speaker index mapping in the response.

sentences_limit.description: Maximum number of sentences to return per call (when include_sentences is true).

sentences_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for sentence pagination (when include_sentences is true).

sentence_start_ms_gte.description: Filter to sentences whose start_ms is greater than or equal to this value.

sentence_end_ms_lte.description: Filter to sentences whose end_ms is less than or equal to this value.

speaker_id.description: Filter returned sentences to a specific speaker_id.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API key identity, including workspace membership, effective scopes, and current daily quota usage; rejects when the API key is missing, revoked, suspended, or has exceeded its daily_call_limit.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

tool_schemas.name: get_call
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single call by internal call id for the authenticated workspace (never returns calls with status='deleted'); rejects when the call does not exist, belongs to a different workspace, or the API key is invalid or over quota.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

include_raw_metadata.description: Whether to include raw_metadata in the response.

tool_schemas.name: import_calls
tool_schemas.description: Creates or upserts call records from upstream Gong call metadata for the authenticated workspace and optionally enqueues transcript processing; returns per-item results with created/updated/noop status and resulting internal call ids, and rejects when payload validation fails or the API key is invalid or over quota.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

items.description: Batch of Gong call metadata records to import/upsert into this workspace.

gong_call_id.description: Upstream Gong call ID (unique per workspace).

title.description: Call title as provided by Gong.

participants.description: Participants as provided by Gong (stored verbatim).

raw_metadata.description: Opaque upstream metadata blob stored for later reference.

status.description: Initial status to set for the call; deleted is not permitted on create.

enqueue_transcript_processing.description: When true, transitions the call into processing_transcript (or leaves it there) to start/continue transcript generation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry the same import batch without duplicating work.

tool_schemas.name: update_call
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a call in the authenticated workspace, including permitted lifecycle transitions (e.g., retrying transcript processing or soft-deleting); rejects illegal status transitions, attempts to modify immutable identifiers, cross-workspace access, invalid API key, or quota exceeded.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

raw_metadata.description: Updated raw metadata blob (replaces stored value).

status.description: New call status; must follow allowed transitions and 'deleted' performs a soft delete cascading transcript status to 'deleted'.

tool_schemas.name: create_call_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or replaces if allowed) the transcript header for a call in the authenticated workspace and sets its initial status; the transcript inherits workspace_id and call_id from the parent call, and rejects when the call is not in the workspace, when the call is deleted, or when validation fails.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

call_id.description: Internal call ID the transcript belongs to.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for the transcript (e.g., en-US).

speaker_index.description: Mapping of speaker_id to speaker metadata (keys are speaker_id).

topics.description: Optional topics assigned/detected for the call transcript.

status.description: Initial transcript status; 'deleted' is not permitted on create.

tool_schemas.name: add_transcript_sentences
tool_schemas.description: Appends or upserts timestamped transcript sentences for a transcript in the authenticated workspace; enforces unique ordinal per transcript and speaker_id existence in the transcript speaker_index, and rejects duplicates, invalid speakers, cross-workspace access, deleted parents, invalid API key, or quota exceeded.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request (passed as the vendor-issued key string).

transcript_id.description: Internal transcript ID to add sentences to.

mode.description: Insert rejects existing ordinals; upsert replaces existing rows with the same ordinal for this transcript.

sentences.description: Sentences to insert/upsert; each sentence is tied to transcript_id and inherits call_id/workspace_id from the transcript.

speaker_id.description: Speaker identifier that must exist in the transcript speaker_index.

start_ms.description: Sentence start offset in milliseconds from call start.

end_ms.description: Sentence end offset in milliseconds from call start.

ordinal.description: Ordering index unique per transcript; retrieval is sorted ascending.

confidence.description: Optional ASR confidence score from 0 to 1.

metadata.name: Gong MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Gong call metadata and the associated transcript content broken into speakers, topics, and timestamped sentences. The main workflows are syncing/importing calls from Gong, listing calls for clients, and retrieving structured transcripts for one or more calls. Repository: https://
